issues.description: The problem statement says `calculateTotalPrice(Meal)` must be `static` because it uses the shared static `stock`, but the reference solution implements `calculateTotalPrice(Meal)` as an instance method (`public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)`). This inconsistency can confuse students and may cause mismatches with expected method signatures in tests/call sites.
issues.suggestedFix: Align spec and solution: either (a) change the solution signature to `public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` (and update any call sites accordingly), or (b) remove the 'must be static' requirement for `calculateTotalPrice` from the problem statement.
